chunks.chunk_id: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology, Vol 14, 2021_0_8f5862e3
chunks.text:
Ingredient: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)
Category: Antioxidant & Barrier Repair
Potential_uses: Regulates sebum production, Reduces hyperpigmentation and redness, Strengthens skin barrier lipid matrix, Minimizes appearance of enlarged pores
Skin_types: oily, combination, dry, normal, sensitive
Cautions: Concentrations above 10% can cause transient flushing or irritation in sensitive individuals, Avoid combining in high concentrations with strong acidic exfoliating treatments simultaneously if skin is compromised
Evidence_level: High (Multiple double-blind clinical trials)
Source: Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology, Vol 14, 2021

chunks.text:
Ingredient: Salicylic Acid (BHA)
Category: Beta Hydroxy Acid Exfoliant
Potential_uses: Lipophilic (oil-soluble) exfoliation deep inside pores, Dissolves sebum, dead skin cell buildup, and clogged pores, Reduces comedones (blackheads and whiteheads), Mild anti-inflammatory properties
Skin_types: oily, combination, acne-prone
Cautions: Can cause mild dryness, flaking, or tightness during initial weeks, Always apply broad-spectrum sunscreen daily during use, Avoid using on damaged, compromised, or eczema-prone skin, Do not combine with strong retinoids or benzoyl peroxide in the same application step unless tolerated
Evidence_level: High (FDA approved topical OTC acne active)
Source: Dermatologic Surgery & Clinical Therapeutics Review, 2022

Ingredient: Hyaluronic Acid (Sodium Hyaluronate)
Category: Humectant Hydration
Potential_uses: Binds up to 1000x its weight in water to hydrate surface skin layers, Plumps fine dehydration lines, Soothes tight or parched skin feeling
Skin_types: dry, dehydrated, sensitive, normal, oily, combination
Cautions: In dry arid environments, apply onto damp skin and lock with an occlusive moisturizer to prevent transepidermal moisture loss
Evidence_level: High (Standard cosmetic dermatological humectant)
Source: International Journal of Cosmetic Science, 2020

chunks.chunk_id: American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) Retinoid Guidelines_0_1d077f59
chunks.text:
Ingredient: Retinol (Vitamin A Derivatives)
Category: Cellular Turnover & Anti-Aging
Potential_uses: Accelerates epidermal cell turnover, Stimulates collagen synthesis to smooth texture and fine lines, Unclogs pores and prevents acne lesion formation, Fades post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH)
Skin_types: normal, oily, combination, mature
Cautions: Requires gradual introduction (sandwich technique, 1-2 times weekly initially), Can cause retinization (redness, flaking, dryness, purging), Must not be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding, Mandatory daily broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen use
Evidence_level: Extremely High (Gold standard dermatological active)
Source: American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) Retinoid Guidelines

chunks.text:
Ingredient: Centella Asiatica (Cica / Madecassoside)
Category: Soothing & Barrier Repair
Potential_uses: Reduces cutaneous erythema (redness) and inflammation, Accelerates skin barrier repair and wound healing, Calms active flare-ups and irritation
Skin_types: sensitive, dry, irritated, acne-prone, all
Cautions: Rare risk of contact allergy; general profile is extremely safe and gentle
Evidence_level: Moderate to High (Phytotherapy & Barrier Repair Studies)
Source: Advances in Dermatology and Allergology, 2019

Ingredient: Ceramides (NP, AP, EOP)
Category: Skin Barrier Lipids
Potential_uses: Restores essential stratum corneum lipid barrier, Prevents transepidermal water loss (TEWL), Protects against environmental irritants and pollutants
Skin_types: dry, sensitive, compromised barrier, normal, combination
Cautions: Extremely well tolerated with no known common contraindications
Evidence_level: High (Core physiological skin lipids)
Source: Archives of Dermatological Research, 2021

Ingredient: Azelaic Acid (10% OTC)
Category: Dicarboxylic Acid / Brightening
Potential_uses: Inhibits tyrosinase to fade dark spots and melasma, Reduces rosacea-associated erythema and pustules, Antimicrobial activity against C. acnes bacteria, Gently unclogs pores
Skin_types: sensitive, acne-prone, hyperpigmentation, combination, oily
Cautions: May cause initial mild tingling or itching upon application, Introduce slowly if skin is reactive
Evidence_level: High (Clinical trial backed for acne & rosacea)
Source: British Journal of Dermatology, 2023

Ingredient: Zinc PCA
Category: Sebum Regulating & Antibacterial
Potential_uses: Regulates 5-alpha reductase to control excess sebum output, Inhibits bacterial proliferation linked to acne breakouts, Promotes healing without drying
Skin_types: oily, acne-prone, combination
Cautions: Generally non-irritating when formulated appropriately
Evidence_level: Moderate (Cosmetic Science Research)
Source: Journal of Applied Cosmetology, 2020
